title: How Can Ants Carry Many Times Their Weight?
description:
An ant can lift loads that would be impossible at human scale.

Small size changes the scaling: muscle force relates to cross-sectional area, while body mass grows with volume. Multiple legs and exoskeleton design also help.

Exact carrying multiples vary widely by species and task; avoid one universal number.

As animals get smaller, their strength relative to body weight generally increases.
